beats.say: Matthew Perry's new Netflix documentary features no main cast members.
Rolling Stone reports Jennifer Aniston and Courteney Cox did not participate in the three part series.
The Guardian notes the project offers a loving tribute to the late star who passed away in 2023 aged 54.
Variety calls it a tragic and mournful portrait of addiction featuring his younger half sister Mia Perry Bowick.
Rolling Stone also reveals Matthew Perry had his first audition for Friends on a Wednesday.
Warren Littlefield, the former head of NBC Entertainment, also appears in the emotional new series.
